definitions.explanation: The act of playing music on an instrument.

examples.japanese: ピアノを{演奏|えんそう}する。
{素晴|すば}らしい{演奏|えんそう}だった。
{生|なま}{演奏|えんそう}を{聴|き}く。
examples.english: To listen to a live performance.

notes:
{演奏|えんそう} refers to musical performance.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {演奏|えんそう}する (to perform, to play)
- {演奏|えんそう}を{聴|き}く (to listen to a performance)
- {演奏|えんそう}{会|かい} (concert, recital)
- {演奏|えんそう}{者|しゃ} (performer, musician)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生|なま}{演奏|えんそう}: live performance
- ソロ{演奏|えんそう}: solo performance
- {演奏|えんそう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: playing technique
